description: Implementation of FileCacheReader class for reading and caching file data, including path resolution and cache management.

classes.name: FileCacheReader
classes.description: Class for reading files with caching mechanism, path resolution, and size retrieval.

methods.name: FileCacheReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with filename and cache size, resolving the full path.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into buffer, refilling cache as needed.

methods.name: GetAbsolutePathName
methods.description: Returns the absolute path of the file.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: EnsureFileOpened
methods.description: Opens the file if not already opened.

methods.name: ReadFromCache
methods.description: Reads data from the cache into the output buffer.

methods.name: RefillCacheIfEmpty
methods.description: Refills the cache if it has been fully read.
